newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Sorini says 1996 net down 25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Sorini says 1996 net down 25 percent.

text.p: Indonesian tapioca starch-based sorbitol producer PT Sorbitol Inti Murni Corporation (Sorini) said on Thursday it estimated its 1996 net profit to drop by about 25 percent from 16.3 billion rupiah in 1995.

"The audited results have not been completed yet, but we estimate our 1996 net profit to fall by around 25 percent because of stiff competition during the year," Sorini president-director Haryanto Adikusumo told reporters after a shareholders' meeting.
Haryanto, however, said he expected the firm to book improved earnings in 1997, but did not elaborate.
Haryanto also said Sorini shareholders on Thursday approved a proposal to increase the firm's authorised capital to 400 billion rupiah from 200 billion rupiah.
The change in the company's authorised capital was in line with government regulations, Haryanto said, declining to give further details.
